title: Learning guitar, banjo and violin technique
summary: He taught himself banjo and guitar after learning to read through violin.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: So the first instrument you learned was the violin? No, the guitar.
And then when you went to Dave Perkins, he taught you the violin? The violin, yeah. He didn't play the violin, he just knew.

The one thing about it, I didn't learn to like somebody playing the violin, a teacher, you learn to position the thing out of, you know, to regulate your hands, like you do with any strings. I didn't learn that, but I did learn how it was a pretty good reader on it, you see. I didn't learn how to jazz on it or nothing, you see. You look at yourself.
And your father played the guitar? Yes, he played the guitar.
He played the guitar, the viola, because they had a viola around the house all the time. But naturally after the family got, you know, growing large, he had to stop playing music completely, you see.
